category: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control (PR.AA)
subcategory_text: Identities are proofed and bound to credentials based on the context of interactions
informative_references: ISO/IEC 27001:2022: Annex A.8.2, Annex A.8.3, Annex A.8.5
implementation_examples: Verify a person's claimed identity at enrollment time using government-issued identity credentials (e.g., passport, visa, driver's license)
Issue a different credential for each person (i.e., no credential sharing)
assessment_objectives: Determine whether identities are proofed and bound to credentials based on the context of interactions.
Determine whether activities are conducted to verify a person's claimed identity at enrollment time using government-issued identity credentials (e.g., passport, visa, driver's license).
Determine whether mechanisms ensure that issue a different credential for each person (i.e., no credential sharing).
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
